summary: 100-foot steel tower in Tuscaloosa County, Alabama, run by the Alabama Forestry Commission; NHLR-registered 2016 and described as used for communications. Build date not found.

facts.status_note: NHLR description (2016 registration) says the tower houses communications equipment, and its cab is rusting with a missing floor and windows. Condition since 2016 is unknown.

events.note: Registered May 27, 2016 as US 1129, AL 62; nominated by Andrew Zerbe

evidence.supports: administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission
100-foot steel tower used to house communications equipment
evidence.quote: This 100-foot steel tower is currently being used to house communications equipment.

sources.title: Thomas Kaufmann: Keeping Alabama's historic lookout towers

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 2016 NHLR page is the only source with tower-specific content. The Forest Lookouts page has a header only (Pine Mountain, Tuscaloosa County, Alabama Forestry Commission). Two searches found nothing usable on build year, staffing or fires for this tower. The Kaufmann column is statewide context and does not name Pine Mountain. The brief record matches the sources on county, agency, registry number, 2016 registration and elevation (979 ft, 298 m). Access and visit are left out because no source states them. Status standing rests only on the 2016 description. Not verified: current condition, whether the tower is still used for communications, and public access. No photos added; the NHLR page credits an Andrew Zerbe photo but gives no image URL.
